name: browser-tabs
title: Browser Tabs
description: Every tab open in your browsers, with its favicon: `enter` switches to it, and you can close, mute or copy it from the list.
author: pal

settings.label: DevTools port
settings.description: The --remote-debugging-port of a Chromium browser (Chrome, Brave, Edge, Chromium). When something listens there its tabs come over the DevTools protocol, with playing and muted state; otherwise the browsers below are asked.

settings.label: Scriptable browsers
settings.description: macOS only: browsers asked over AppleScript when they are running, by app name. A Chromium browser already on the DevTools port is skipped.

settings.label: Firefox
settings.text: List Firefox tabs from its session file
settings.description: Read-only: Firefox has no scripting interface, so Focus only raises its window.

settings.label: Firefox session file
settings.description: A sessionstore-backups/recovery.jsonlz4; empty finds the most recent profile's.

store.tagline: Switch to any open tab of Chrome, Safari or Firefox
features: Tabs from Chrome, Safari and Firefox, and any Chromium browser with remote debugging on
Tab titles show up in the main search, so typing a page's name finds it
Filters for All, Playing sound and This window
Close (`cmd+w`), mute (`cmd+m`), copy the address (`cmd+c`) or a markdown link (`cmd+shift+c`)
Firefox tabs can be listed and focused, but not closed or muted

screenshots.caption: The tabs of two browsers in their own order, the host as the subtitle, playing and muted tagged
The Audible filter: only the tabs a page reports as playing sound, across windows
Focus, Copy URL, Mute, Copy as markdown link, and Close last
Live: tab titles are root results, so part of one typed at the root finds the tab

actions.title: Focus
actions.description: Selects the tab in the browser, then raises its window; for Firefox only the window.

actions.title: Mute / Unmute
actions.description: DevTools tabs only: the page's media elements, not Chrome's tab mute.

tabs.title: Browser Tabs
tabs.description: Open tabs across Chrome, Safari and Firefox.
